title: PC98 style dating sim game built for fun
author: jennolopea_
selftext:
I was generating pixel art for fun and decided to make an actual dating sim game for fun. Playable demo:

https://white-bay-0b4b0140f.7.azurestaticapps.net/

There is a certain charm to 16/32 bit pixel art.

comments.author: No-Tip7022
comments.body: Ui Looks Great keep it up, make sure there are lots of choices

replies.author: jennolopea_
replies.body: Yeah. I think I need to make the UI smaller and add more branching stories

replies.author: pcoutcast
replies.body: The UI definitely needs to be much harder to read to be truly authentic. But seriously this looks great!

comments.author: Afraid_Test6461
comments.body: Nice man what is your stack?

replies.author: Afraid_Test6461
replies.body: Nothing fancy but impressive. Great job

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: These dating sims are so creepy. It’s equivalent to having an AI girlfriend/boyfriend.

comments.author: Comfortable-Ant916
comments.body: The pixel art is sick but ever since I started using Lurvessa the scripted stuff feels hollow. It is fucking scary how realistic the conversations get now. Still gonna check your demo out for the aesthetic though.
